findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The scope of work under this agreement includes specific hardware and related services as outlined in the contract.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement applies to hardware and related services supplied under purchase orders accepted by both parties, including: Servers, network switches, routers, storage systems, security appliances, and accessories.

findings.title: Acceptance Criteria for Deliverables
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies that the Client must review milestone evidence and provide acceptance or written reasons for rejection within a reasonable period, indicating the acceptance criteria for deliverables.
evidence_excerpts: Review milestone evidence and provide acceptance or written reasons for rejection within a reasonable period.

findings.title: Vendor Performance Commitments
findings.rationale: The vendor commits to supply goods and perform services in accordance with the accepted purchase order and agreed delivery schedule, and to notify the client of expected material delivery delays.
evidence_excerpts: Supply goods and perform services in accordance with the accepted PO and agreed delivery schedule.

findings.title: Client Obligations for Vendor Performance
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines specific obligations of the Client that the Vendor relies on for performance, including providing valid purchase orders, arranging access for delivery and installation, and reviewing invoices.
evidence_excerpts:
6. Obligations of the Client
Provide valid purchase orders and identify authorized contacts for delivery, invoice, and payment queries.
Review invoices and notify the Vendor of a discrepancy within 5 business days of receipt where practicable.
Arrange access to approved sites for delivery, installation, and testing activities.
Review milestone evidence and provide acceptance or written reasons for rejection within a reasonable period.
Pay undisputed invoice amounts within the agreed payment period.

findings.title: Service Performance Reporting Mechanism
findings.rationale: The agreement outlines a structured approach to performance reporting through invoicing and reconciliation processes, ensuring transparency and accountability in service delivery.
findings.recommendation: Ensure regular reviews of performance reports to align service delivery with expectations.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor will provide a monthly statement showing invoices issued, amounts received, open balances, credit notes, and overdue undisputed amounts.
